messages:
alex: Quick design review note — noticed the in-console docs panel uses different terminology than our docs site. Console labels the sidebar item as `Runbook` (singular) and the panel header as `Runbook guide`, but the docs site and search use `Runbooks` (plural) and `Runbook playbooks`. This causes confusion in support tickets. Anyone else seeing this?

maya: Yep saw that. I also think the panel is too wide and pushes UX chrome off-screen on smaller windows. We debated a collapsible right rail in the last iteration, might be time to revisit. :eyes:

sam: From DevEx perspective: can we standardize the term first (Runbook vs Runbooks vs Playbook) before changing layout? Copy tweaks are quick, layout changes need engineering time. Also accessibility nits — the header doesn't have an ARIA label and the contrast on the link color fails AA in a few spots.

zara: @alex good catch. Docs canonical is `Runbooks` (plural) — we coined that for the docs taxonomy. If console switches to match, we should add a redirect/canonical link so old URLs don't break. We can add an anchor like `#runbooks` and recommend stable permalinks.

jordan: Engineering note — prefer lazy-loading the docs panel content to avoid penalizing first paint. If we add cross-links we should hit the docs API for structured metadata (title, canonical_id, last_updated) instead of embedding full pages. I can prototype an endpoint that returns JSON metadata + html snippet.

alex: Good call. Proposal: 1) adopt docs canonical term `Runbooks` across Console; 2) add a small in-product docs header with title, last-updated, and a `View full doc` link to docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/<canonical_id>; 3) lazy-load the panel and keyboard-focus trap it when open.

maya: For the prototype I'll try two layout options: a slim collapsible rail (desktop) and a modal drawer (mobile). I'll mock both in Figma and include keyboard-nav flows.

sam: Copy checklist: update menu label, panel header, tooltip text, and the search results snippet. Accessibility checklist: aria-label on header, focus management when opening/closing, link underline on focus, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text. I'll add these as follow-up tasks in the UX ticket.

zara: I can add cross-linking guidance to docs: include a small metadata block at the top of runbook pages like: ```
Canonical-ID: runbooks/incident-response
Short-title: Incident response runbook
```
This makes it easier for Console to show stable permalinks.

jordan: Quick implementation question — are we okay rendering the docs markdown as sanitized HTML in-console or do we need a full markdown viewer? Sanitized HTML is easier but interactive widgets in docs might break.

maya: For MVP go sanitized HTML + inline code highlighting, no widgets. If we need interactivity later we can embed via iframe.

alex: Timeline idea: Maya prototype by EOW, Sam to update copy/accessibility checklist and push PR for text changes, Zara to add canonical metadata by next sprint, Jordan to spec lazy-load API. We can gate the layout change behind a small A/B test.

sam: Sounds good. I'll create a short checklist and a PR template for any doc-to-console term changes so we don't accidentally diverge later. :+1:

azara (note): tagging fix: @zara -> zara (typo earlier) :sweat_smile:

alex: Thanks everyone — please drop short notes in the product ticket #PRD-4212 so we have a single source of truth.

(automated) deploy-bot: New branch `feature/console-runbooks-docs` created by jordan.
